Male Russian abducted by 4 male Koreans
and Detained by Japanese Gendarmerie.

On instructions from the P.A. to D.C.(Crime) on
6/7/41, the two arrested Russians: 1)Gorlinsky and
2) Liapunoff were placed in the M.T.C. Book, their
numbers being 67 and 68 respectively.

The finger prints of the 2nd named show that he has
one previous conviction for being drunk and disorderly.

On 22/7/41 the 1st named Russian having recovered
from his injuries, was discharged from the Police
Hospital and brought to this Station. His finger prints
were taken, he has no criminal record.

On 22/7/41 the two arrested men were questioned by
the undersigned.

Gorlinsky admitted having attempted to extort money
from Koreans, posing as an S.M.P. detective, when he
was assaulted, disarmed and taken by the Koreans to the
Japanese Naval Landing Party at the North Railway Station.

Liapunoff admitted having lent his pistol to
Gorlinsky, well knowing that the latter intended to
commit an extortion.

Detailed written statements taken from both men.

On 25/7/41 D.S. Tsuji (Central) attended this
Station and translated the letter to the Commissioner
of Police from the Japanese Naval Landing Party,

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 25 JUL 1941）
（批：Bch S.1）

警察医院、侦探股办公室、日本领事馆、
浙江路274弄，以及侦探。

一名俄国男子被四名朝鲜男子绑架，
并被日本宪兵队拘留。

根据警务助理处长（P.A.）于1941年7月6日
向犯罪科副主管（D.C. Crime）发出的指示，两名被捕的俄国人：1) Gorlinsky 和
2) Liapunoff 被录入机动交通科（M.T.C.）登记簿，
他们的编号分别为 67 和 68。

第二名被捕者的指纹显示，他此前曾因
醉酒滋事被判刑一次。

1941年7月22日，第一名被捕的俄国人伤势
痊愈，从警察医院出院并被带至本捕房。采集了
他的指纹，他没有犯罪记录。

1941年7月22日，这两名被捕者接受了
下述签署人的讯问。

Gorlinsky 承认曾冒充工部局警务处（S.M.P.）侦探，
企图向朝鲜人勒索钱财，期间遭到殴打、缴械，
并被朝鲜人带往北火车站的日本海军陆战队。

Liapunoff 承认将自己的手枪借给了
Gorlinsky，且明知后者意图实施勒索。

已获取两人的详细书面供词。

1941年7月25日，辻（Tsuji）警佐（中央巡捕房）来到本
捕房，并翻译了日本海军陆战队致警务处处长的信函，

mentioned in diary 2. Translation follows:-

Translation of a letter addressed to Commissioner of
Police from Commander of the J.M.L.P. Settlement Force
regarding handing over a Foreigner suspected in a case
of Extortion.
-O-
1. Date of the Occurrence:-About 1 a.m. 5/7/41.
2. Place of the Occurrence:-No.11 Fooling Li, Chekiang Rd.
3. Complainant:- Kengo Yanagawa.
4. Suspected:-V.V.Gorlinsky,26,Russian,residing at No.85
Joffre Terrace, off Avenue Joffre, F.C.
-O-
The above mentioned suspected man, on obtaining
information that the complainant was selling heroin,
committed armed extortion at the above mentioned time,
date and place, however, his pistol was seized by the
complainant, K.Yanagawa and his friend named Gen(    ),
address unknown. The suspected man then attempted to
run away through Fooling Li alleyway. At this juncture
a few men seemed to be Japanese, their names and
addresses unknown, rendered assistance to the complainant
and took hold of the suspected man, who was taken on
a motor car to the Szechuen Road Bridge, where sentry of
the J.M.L.P. was reported of this case. This case was
therefore investigated by the J.M.L.P. Settlement Force,
as the result of which Kengo Yanagawa admitted the fact
that he had sold heroin at the aforementioned place,
therefore he was sent to the Japanese Consular Police,
while the suspected Foreigner was handed over to the
S.M.P. together with one pistol and one magazine,
containing seven rounds, as the scene of the offence
being situated in the Settlement which is justified the
Foreigner to be questioned by the S.M.P.
P.O. The pistol is requested to be returned to the
Settlement Force after your investigations, which is
necessary for enquiries by the Settlement Force.

On 23/7/41 D.S. Hill, D.S. Tsuji, C.D.S.247 and
the undersigned took Gorlinsky to the place of occurrence,
House Noll Lane 274 Chekiang Road (Foh Ling Li) but no
Koreans were located there, and enquiries amongst the
inmates ascertained that they had vacated the room on the
following day (6/7/41).

日记2中提及的内容。译文如下：-

日本海军陆战队租界部队指挥官就移交一名涉嫌
勒索案的外国人一事致警务处处长的信函译文。
-O-
1. 事发日期：- 1941年7月5日凌晨1点左右。
2. 事发地点：- 浙江路福宁里11号。
3. 投诉人：- 柳川健吾 (Kengo Yanagawa)。
4. 嫌疑人：- V.V. Gorlinsky，26岁，俄国人，居住于
法租界霞飞路旁霞飞坊85号。
-O-
上述嫌疑人在获悉投诉人贩卖海洛因后，
于上述时间、日期和地点实施了武装勒索，然而，
其手枪被投诉人 K. Yanagawa 及其一位名为 Gen(    )
的朋友（地址不详）缴获。随后嫌疑人试图通过
福宁里弄堂逃跑。此时，几名看似为日本人的人
（姓名和地址不详）协助了投诉人，并控制了嫌疑人，
将其用汽车带至四川路桥，并向日本海军陆战队的
哨兵报告了此案。因此，日本海军陆战队租界部队
对此案进行了调查，结果柳川健吾承认了在所述地点
贩卖海洛因的事实，故将其移送至日本领事馆警察，
而该外籍嫌疑人则连同手枪一支及装有七发子弹的
弹匣一个，一并移交给工部局警务处（S.M.P.），因为
案发地点位于租界内，工部局警务处有权对该外国人
进行讯问。
附注：请在调查结束后将手枪归还给
租界部队，以便租界部队进行后续查询。

1941年7月23日，希尔（Hill）警佐、辻（Tsuji）警佐、
刑事侦探副警长（C.D.S.）247号以及下述签署人
带领 Gorlinsky 前往案发地点，即浙江路274弄
（福宁里）诺尔寓所（House Noll），但那里没有
朝鲜人，经询问住户得知，他们已于次日
（1941年7月6日）搬离该房间。

At the request of the undersigned, D.S. Tsuji
made enquiries at the Japanese Consular Police regarding
the Korean Kengo Yanagawa, the heroin peddler mentioned
in the above letter.
On 24/7/41 D.S. Tsuji informed the undersigned that
on 9/7/41 the above named Korean was tried at the Japanese
Consular Court with selling heroin when he was fined and
released.
He gave his address as 64 Chusan Road, but this
address proved to be false, no Koreans residing on the
premises, the house is occupied by German refugees.
The would be complainant in the case of attempted
extortion the Korean Kengo Yanagawa could not be located.
The offence of attempted extortion now becomes
subject of F.I.R.3016/41 Louza and on instructions from
the D.O."A", the two Russians will be brought before
the S.S.D.Court on 26/7/41 charged accordingly.

进行了查询。
1941年7月24日，辻（Tsuji）警佐通知下述签署人，
上述朝鲜人于1941年7月9日在日本领事馆法庭
因贩卖海洛因受审，被罚款后释放。
他提供的地址是中山路64号，但该地址
经查证为虚假，该处并无朝鲜人居住，房屋由
德国难民占用。
在企图勒索案中作为所谓投诉人的朝鲜人
柳川健吾无法找到。

初步调查报告（F.I.R.）的主题，根据“A”分区
侦探主管（D.O. "A"）的指示，两名俄国人将于
1941年7月26日被提解至特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court），
并被提起相应指控。

Male Russian abducted by 4 male Koreans
and detained by Japanese Gendarmerie.

At 3.20 a.m. 5-7-41 informant named Loh Zung
Sang (陸順生)57,Ningpo, chauffeur employed by the
Hwa Li (華利) Garage at 517 Kiukiang Road, and
carrying Driving Permit No. 9428, came to the Station
and reported the following:-

At 12.45 a.m. 5-7-41 a male Korean came to the
Hwa Li Garage and hired a car to take him to Chapei
paying the $5.00 fare in advance. The informant was
detailed to convey the Japanese and driving M/Car
E.M.C. Lic No. 18088 was told by him to go to Chekiang
Road near Kiukiang Road. Outside of Foh Ling Li,
Chekiang Road the informant was told by the Japanese
to stop. The Japanese alighted and went into the
alleyway and about 2 minutes later he returned with
3 other Japanese and a foreigner.

The foreigner was bleeding from the head and
his hands were tied together. The 4 Japanese forced
the foreigner into the car and one of the Japanese
produced a pistol about the size of a .380 pistol
threatening the informant and told him to go to
North Railway Station.

On arrival, the 4 Japanese dragged the foreigner
into the Gendarmerie Station located in the Railway
Station and told the informant to wait. Informant

Loh Zung Sung (陸松生)

Louza n.. 5-7-41. translated
xxxxxx Clerk Chen Kiang Ping

I am 57 years of age, native of Ningpo, married,
and employed by the Hwa Li Garage at No. 617 Kiukiang Road .
I am residing in the garage.

At about 5.20 p.m. 5-7-41 a Japanese came to the
garage and ordered me to drive to Loh Zung Li, Chekiang
Road. Then he paid $5.00 in advance. A motor car □□□□.
Lic. No. 13035 was sent out of the said place. When
arriving at the south of the Loh Zung Li, Chekiang Road,
the car was stopped by the order of the Japanese.

Then I perceived 3 Japanese together with 1 foreigner
age about 30 years whose hands were bound with rope and
whose mouth was gagged. These four then entered the motor
car and ordered me to drive to Gendarmerie Station at
Chapoo Road near □□□□ Road.

After arriving at the said destination, they stayed
for a few minutes and then ordered me to drive to the
Japanese Gendarmerie Station at the North Railway Station.

Again reaching the spot the 4 Japanese brought
the foreigners into the Station. After I waited outside
for about 2 and a half hours the Japanese came out
and ordered me to drive the car back to the garage.

Arriving at the garage, I immediately reported the
case to the Louza Station where the detectives told me to
lead them to the Japanese Gendarmerie Station at the
North Railway Station for further investigations.

True Statement.

Signed and cross-marked.
Loh Zung Sung.

陆松生

老闸捕房 1941年7月5日。译毕
xxxxxx 职员陈江平（音译）

我现年57岁，宁波人，已婚，受雇于九江路617号华利汽车行（Hwa Li Garage）。
我居住在车行内。

1941年7月5日下午5时20分左右，一名日本人来到车行，命令我驾车前往浙江路罗宗里（Loh Zung Li）。随后他预付了5.00美元。一辆车牌号为13035的汽车□□□□从该处驶出。当到达浙江路罗宗里南端时，该车奉日本人之命停下。

随后，我看见3名日本人与1名约30岁的外国人在一起，该外国人的双手被绳索捆绑，嘴部被塞住。这四人随即进入汽车，命令我驾车前往靠近□□□□路的乍浦路宪兵队驻地。

到达上述目的地后，他们停留了几分钟，然后命令我驾车前往北站日本宪兵队驻地。

再次抵达该地后，4名日本人将那名外国人带入宪兵队驻地。我在外面等候了约两个半小时后，日本人出来，命令我将车开回车行。

回到车行后，我立即向老闸捕房报案，巡捕房侦探指示我带他们前往北站日本宪兵队驻地进行进一步调查。

属实陈述。

签名并画押。
陆松生。
